51554444.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant wildtype IDH1 (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) pLysS cells assessed as dissociation constant by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry Studies. ITC was conducted using a Malvern MicroCal PEAQ-ITC Automated machine (Malvern Panalytical). In general, IDH1 was prepared in 50 mM tris–HCl, pH 7.5, and the compounds were dissolved in the same buffer. 400 μL of cell solution containing 40 μM IDH1 [4% (v/v) DMSO] and 200 μL of the titrant containing 200 or 400 μM compound [2% or 4% (v/v) DMSO] were transferred to an ITC plate (Malvern Panalytical WEL020854-010). Titrations were conducted at 25 °C with an initial delay of 60 s and a stir speed of 750 rpm. The injection setup consisted of 19 injections, with 1 initial injection of 0.4 μL and 18 subsequent injections of 2.0 μL each with 150 s between the injections. Thermodynamic parameters were obtained using MicroCal PEAQ-ITC analysis software.
